title: Leader, Client Operations
teaser: Become part of our team as a Leader, Client Operations, providing strategic oversight and operational leadership for Cisco’s sellers across ASEAN and GC theatres. Drive process optimisation, automation, and stakeholder engagement to support business growth. Ideal for experienced professionals with deep field operational expertise and strong cross-functional leadership skills.
description:
Role Overview

As a critical member within Commerce Operations (CO), the Field Operations Leader will provide operational leadership and strategic oversight for Cisco’s sellers across ASEAN and GC theatres. This role requires close collaboration with sales executives and cross-functional teams to operationalize and transform sales operations, driving business growth through process optimization, automation, and stakeholder engagement. The role embraces a digital-first, agile approach to streamline operations, reduce friction, and accelerate business transformation in complex and dynamic markets.

Your Impact

Commit Management

Participate in forecast calls to identify and prioritise weekly, monthly, and quarterly objectives

Lead the operationalization of weekly commit targets by coordinating with Sales, Channel, Engineering, Finance, IT, and Customer Service teams

Prepare "Sneak Peek" reports for the respective Theatre and Segment during critical period-ends.

Business Partnership & Advisory

Build and maintain strong partnerships with theatre sales leadership, providing daily operational support.

Advise on field and customer operations, including enablement and change management related to tools, policies, and processes.

Provide supply chain consultation and manage constraints effectively.

Design operational solutions for complex deals and ensure deal readiness.

Manage booking quality and backlog, including analysis and resolution.

Conduct stakeholder operational business reviews.

Guide sales teams on Cisco's crediting, compensation policies, bookings policies, offer types, and incentive program changes.

Manage escalations with ownership at the executive level.

Process Improvement & Strategic Growth

Proactively identify field challenges, gather feedback, and ensure closed-loop resolution.

Drive process and system automation by submitting change requests and collaborating with IT and process managers through implementation.

Drive awareness and adoption of new solutions and enhancements.

Commit to continuous self-learning, particularly regarding new business consumption models, software, and acquisitions.

Talent Development

Provide ongoing coaching and mentorship to team members to enhance their skills and career development.

Implement performance assessment frameworks to regularly evaluate employee performance and provide constructive feedback.

Identify training needs and develop training plan that address team skill gaps and promote continuous learning.

 

Minimum Qualifications

Education & Language

Degree: BA/BS degree or equivalent.

Experience: 15+ years of related experience.

Certification: Project Management Certificate is a plus.

Language: Proficient in written and spoken English. Proficiency in Mandarin is required to effectively communicate and collaborate with Mandarin-speaking customers, partners, and stakeholders as part of the role.

Experience & Skills

Deep knowledge of End-to-End (E2E) field operational processes.

Rich experience working within a channel business structure.

Proven ability to drive cross functional and/or global initiatives.

Experience leading change management in environments undergoing significant business transformation.

Advantageous Experience: Cisco ordering/technology knowledge (Product, Services, or Software), Sales Operations, Partner Programs (incentives, pricing, rebates), and Software Operations/Enterprise Agreement deal structures.

AI Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity; experience developing basic AI solutions is highly desirable.

IT Foundation: Solid understanding of IT principles and infrastructure; programming knowledge is an advantage.

General Expectations

Strong business acumen, planning, and organizational skills with the ability to meet tight deadlines.

Proficiency in data analytics and ability to translate data into actionable business intelligence.

Program management skills to convert business objectives into actionable plans.

Solution-oriented mindset with capability to identify root causes and implement changes.

Adaptability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with a proactive, take-charge attitude.

Excellent relationship management skills to build and maintain internal and external partnerships.

Outstanding communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.

Ability to coach and mentor team members to enhance operational capabilities.

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
